offering_description.value: Pagaya runs an AI-powered network that connects consumer credit demand with institutional capital. It uses machine learning to evaluate loan applications from lending partners such as banks, credit unions and fintechs, and funds or sells the resulting loans and asset-backed securities to institutional investors.

primary_products.value: personal loans; auto loans; credit card receivables; point-of-sale financing; asset-backed securities

primary_services.value: AI credit decisioning for lending partners; loan origination support; asset management for institutional investors

customer_segment.value: B2B: Banks, credit unions, auto lenders, fintechs and institutional investors such as asset managers and insurers; B2C: Consumers applying for loans and credit cards through partner lenders

end_markets.value: consumer finance; personal lending; auto lending; credit cards; point-of-sale financing; capital markets

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: Fees from lending partners per loan originated through the network; commissions or management fees: Asset management and performance fees from funds and investor vehicles; interest or premiums: Interest and investment income on loans and securities held on balance sheet
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; commissions or management fees; interest or premiums

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: Matches loan applications from partner lenders with institutional capital, sells loans and securities to investors; software / platform: AI underwriting platform integrated with lending partners' origination systems

geography_served.value: US national: Operates primarily in the United States, with R&D and offices in Israel

specialization.value: related lines: Personal loans, auto, credit cards and point-of-sale financing on one AI lending network

distribution_channels.value: partners / resellers: Lending partners' channels: banks, credit unions, auto lenders and fintechs; direct sales: Direct relationships with institutional investors buying loans and securities; online: Consumer-facing loan and credit card applications via partners' sites

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Consumer lending and securities rules: CFPB, SEC, state lending licenses, fair lending and bank partner oversight
